card.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. Could you stay for the part that isn't the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit with me for nine. I don't want the last thing we fixed tonight to be the sink.

mechanism: A asks B to remain after cleanup so the relationship, not only the room, can be repaired before departure.
confusable: Unlike prolonging company generally, the request must tie continued presence to an unresolved emotional repair.
comparison: D74-a works within the last-bus limit; D74-b accepts lateness rather than enter dinner with distrust intact.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
